Hi all — looked at the log. The invite URL that went to HorizonWorks contains a RelayState parameter which should be URL-encoded once. In this case our email template pipeline appears to have applied an extra escaping step, turning the ampersand into %26 and then escaping again, so the final redirect path becomes malformed on the portal side and the gateway returns 404. I pulled the SAML response sample (attached saml-response.txt) and the error from the gateway.

Temporary remediation options:
1) Reissue a plain invite that includes the unescaped RelayState — I can generate and send a one-off activation link from the admin console (valid for 48 hours).
2) Manual account activation: we can create the supplier record on your behalf and attach the PO; requires a signed confirmation email from HorizonWorks and will bypass the self-service activation flow.

I will open a ticket with infra (INF-2143) to remove the extra escaping step in the email templating flow. ETA for remediation code change: 72 hours (tentative) — will advise.

Ben
